title: Classify operator intertwining at a live COPY boundary
body:
Classify legal simultaneous rebasing at live COPY cuts

Classify simultaneous scalar helper/snapshot basis changes at one live ERASE cut for arbitrary nonzero linear snapshot operators over F2.

Operator intertwining theorem and equal-operator block classification; 8100 complete two-role cases and 141120 three-role cases, literal dirty-input verification, exact paid toy schedule and rejecting false covariance control.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-live-copy-operator-intertwiner`. Positive and meaningful failure controls run under Python 3.12.

Scope and remaining obligations are in the package README. No selected frontier change or new kappa. Prepared for woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. [Coordinated research batch](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18922638); round 02. The selected record is unchanged.
